Self.Wiki: This map object represents a region within the map.

Rotation.Wiki: Rotation of the part, in degrees.

RegionID.Wiki: Identifies the region. Routes refer to occlusion portals by this ID, so keep it unique within the map.

MapStudioLayer.Wiki: The map layer this region is placed on. Smithbox uses it to select regions by layer.

UnkA_Region.Wiki: Read by the game. Only set on occlusion portals: a list of other portals of the map (by their order among the portals).

UnkB_Region.Wiki: Read by the game. Only set on occlusion portals: a second list of other portals of the map.

Common_VariationID.Wiki: -1 for always. Other values (0 to 9) appear on effect regions of the small-base maps and follow the map objects' Variation, but the game was not seen reading this one.

SourceRegionIndex.Wiki: The region number the game uses instead of this region's own position in the list. -1 uses its own. Regions copied onto the distant-view tiles carry the original region's number here.

Common_PartName.Wiki: The region remains inactive until the specified part is rendered. Empty means it is always active.

Common_EntityID.Wiki: Identifies this region in event scripts.
